modmenu.descriptionTranslation.mining-li: Adds features related to mining and ways to control it in a better way
mining-limits.config.shouldRun.desc: Set to §oFalse§r to turn off the mod
mining-limits.config.hasLowHeight.desc: Enables/Disables a low height limit for mining
mining-limits.config.hasHighHeight.desc: Enables/Disables a high height limit for mining
mining-limits.config.isChunkLimited.desc: Limits mining to a single chunk (Other settings still applies)
mining-limits.config.isBlockLimited.desc: Limits mining to a specified list of blocks (Other settings still applies)
mining-limits.config.lowHeight.desc: Lowest height the player can mine
mining-limits.config.highHeight.desc: Highest height the player can mine
mining-limits.config.limitedChunkX.desc: Coordinates of a block inside of that chunk (Chunk position is automatically converted from that block's position)
mining-limits.config.limitedChunkZ.desc: Coordinates of a block inside of that chunk (Chunk position is automatically converted from that block's position)
mining-limits.config.shiftBypass.desc: Allows block breaking when player is sneaking
mining-limits.config.carefulBreaking.des: Reduces the block breaking speed while the player is sneaking
mining-limits.config.carefulBreakingSpee: If your normal breaking speed is under the block's breaking speed, setting this to 1 will just use your normal breaking speed
mining-limits.config.allowedBlocks.desc:
List of blocks that you are §lallowed§r to mine. 
§eINFO:§r New entries §lshould§r follow this pattern: 
§o"block.[MOD_ID].[BLOCK_ID]"§r or §o"block.minecraft.[BLOCK_ID]"§r
mining-limits.config.showOutline.desc: Renders an colored outline on blocks outside limits
mining-limits.config.outlineColor.desc: The color of the outline that appears on non allowed blocks
mining-limits.config.debugMode.desc: Shows what the mod is doing in the game logs (Only use if you are trying to fix something, turning this on could result in poor performance)
mining-limits.message.highHeight: §cBlock height is over mining limits (Too High)
mining-limits.message.lowHeight: §cBlock height is under mining limits (Too Low)
mining-limits.message.notAllowedBlock: §cMining this block is not allowed (Not found in allowedBlocks)
mining-limits.message.other: §cBlock is outside of mining limits (No Provided Reason)
